title: Mindsets and Management: AI and Gender (In)Equitable Access to Finance
models_tested: Proprietary Machine Learning (ML) models for credit assessment used by fintech companies
findings: The paper finds that fintech developers follow 'agnostic' approaches, intentionally not collecting data on religion (or caste and race) in the belief that this makes their machine learning models objective and fair. An interviewee is quoted as saying, 'We don't want to be biased about certain religions, castes, race... We only look at data.' However, the paper's primary critique of this 'blind' approach focuses on its failure to address structural gender inequality, with religion serving as a secondary example of a demographic characteristic that developers ignore.
